caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an ornate, antique mechanical device, possibly a part of a locking or latching mechanism. It is rendered in shades of brown and bronze, suggesting a metallic composition, with areas of oxidation or patina giving it a somewhat greenish tint in places. The object has two large circular openings at opposite ends and several smaller circular details throughout its structure. Decorative elements include scalloped edges, floral or leaf-like patterns, and raised dots or rivets. The device has two main horizontal bars, one above the other, connected by a vertical element and an angled brace, with scrollwork and intricate detailing along the surfaces. The drawing is centered on a tan or cream background, with the artist's name ("Ethel Dougan") and the year ("1883") written in small script below the object.
title: Iron Bit
